From 9430ff992644e9f9c3ba6283cc56d40b421522e9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Xin Long <lucien.xin@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2019 20:06:09 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] sctp: fix ignoring asoc_id for tcp-style sockets on
 SCTP_ENABLE_STREAM_RESET sockopt

A similar fix as Patch "sctp: fix ignoring asoc_id for tcp-style sockets on
SCTP_DEFAULT_SEND_PARAM sockopt" on SCTP_ENABLE_STREAM_RESET sockopt.

Fixes: 99a62135e127 ("sctp: use SCTP_FUTURE_ASSOC and add SCTP_CURRENT_ASSOC for SCTP_ENABLE_STREAM_RESET sockopt")
Signed-off-by: Xin Long <lucien.xin@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/net/sctp/socket.c b/net/sctp/socket.c
index 238e5c804cc9..6b0ee8946bdb 100644
--- a/net/sctp/socket.c
+++ b/net/sctp/socket.c
@@ -4281,6 +4281,9 @@ static int sctp_setsockopt_enable_strreset(struct sock *sk,
 		goto out;
 	}
 
+	if (sctp_style(sk, TCP))
+		params.assoc_id = SCTP_FUTURE_ASSOC;
+
 	if (params.assoc_id == SCTP_FUTURE_ASSOC ||
 	    params.assoc_id == SCTP_ALL_ASSOC)
 		ep->strreset_enable = params.assoc_value;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `net/sctp/socket.c`**
- A new conditional check was added to set `params.assoc_id` to `SCTP_FUTURE_ASSOC` if the socket style is TCP. This modification occurs before the existing checks for `params.assoc_id` values.
  
### Relationships
- The modification in `net/sctp/socket.c` is related to a previous fix that addressed a similar issue with the `SCTP_DEFAULT_SEND_PARAM` socket option. This patch aims to ensure that the association ID is correctly handled for TCP-style sockets when using the `SCTP_ENABLE_STREAM_RESET` socket option, thereby improving the consistency and correctness of socket option handling in SCTP. The change is part of a broader effort to ensure that socket options respect the association ID, particularly for TCP-style sockets.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
asoc = sctp_id2assoc(sk, params.assoc_id);
if (!asoc && params.assoc_id > SCTP_ALL_ASSOC &&
    sctp_style(sk, UDP))
    goto out;
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the association ID (`assoc_id`) is not being correctly assigned for TCP-style sockets when the `SCTP_ENABLE_STREAM_RESET` socket option is set. Specifically, if the `assoc_id` does not correspond to an existing association, the code does not handle the case for TCP-style sockets properly, leading to potential misconfigurations.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (sctp_style(sk, TCP))
    params.assoc_id = SCTP_FUTURE_ASSOC;
```
Reason:
This line ensures that if the socket is of TCP style, the `assoc_id` is set to `SCTP_FUTURE_ASSOC`. This corrects the handling of the association ID for TCP-style sockets, allowing the `SCTP_ENABLE_STREAM_RESET` option to be processed correctly and preventing unexpected behavior.
